topics.title: Need for adjustments and closing stock

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why adjustments are needed under the accrual basis while preparing financial statements.
Record and present closing stock given as an adjustment or shown inside the trial balance.
Treat expenses incurred but unpaid at the year end in the profit and loss account and balance sheet.
Treat expenses paid in advance for the next period in the profit and loss account and balance sheet.

topics.title: Accrued income and income received in advance

concepts.learning_objective: Treat income earned during the year but not yet received.
Treat income received during the year that belongs to the next accounting period.
Record depreciation as an adjustment and show the asset net of depreciation.
Distinguish bad debts in the trial balance from further bad debts given as an adjustment.

topics.title: Provision for bad and doubtful debts

concepts.learning_objective: Create a provision for doubtful debts and show it as a deduction from debtors.
Compute the net charge to profit and loss when an old provision exists.
Calculate the provision for discount on good debtors and show debtors at their expected realisable value.

topics.title: Manager's commission and interest on capital

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate manager's commission on net profit before or after charging such commission.
Calculate interest on capital, including on additional capital, and show its effect on profit and capital.
